(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure and a rear section constructed from a solid structural material; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, wherein said first and second aero covers are made from a polymer material.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus that is greater than 7.8 GPa.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from a polypropylene reinforced with at least 40% long glass fibers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness in a range of about 3.0 mm to about 4.0 mm.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness in a range of about 2.0 mm to about 3.0 mm.
